scope: Outcome-free schema and support inventory; no synthetic magnitudes, model residuals, fits, or cosmology
files: All 339 table rows and their matching TXT/FITS spectra; duplicate CSV column names retained by positional CSV parsing
allowed_arrays: Read wavelength, flux-error finiteness/positivity, FITS/TXT equality and counts only. Do not evaluate flux integrals or model residuals.
training_join: Normalize only leading SN and whitespace/case for exact official designation matches. Compare paper M20 Table1 names, RAISIN photometry cohort/list and 134 DR3 names. Other aliases must be explicit, no fuzzy matching.
no_independence_shortcut: Absence from M20 roster or old photometry lists does not establish absence from the exact SNooPy/Hsiao native training execution. Lu training spectrum split is not object-disjoint validation.
source_limitation: e(Tmax) and sBV are SNooPy multiband outputs; these support counts do not establish an optical-only timing constraint. Future flux-dependent analysis requires a separate frozen protocol.
